text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if the data used to train AI contains unfair patterns, the AI can make decisions that discriminate against certain groups. Fairness means we must check AI systems carefully to ensure they treat everyone equally. Privacy is another key issue, as AI often collects huge amounts of personal information, so we need strict rules to protect it. Transparency is also essential—people should understand how and why an AI makes a particular decision. Finally, responsible AI development requires collaboration between engineers, policymakers, and the public to create technology that benefits society while minimizing harm.
